welcome.title: Welcome to Save Up!
welcome.description: We'll show the main places: adding transactions, reading your budget, checking reports, and adjusting settings.

navigation.title: Bottom menu
navigation.description: Use these buttons to return to the dashboard, open the report, or go to settings at any time.

balance.title: Your balance
balance.description: This is the money currently available. If the starting amount is wrong, tap the number and enter the correct balance.

amount-input.title: Income & expenses
amount-input.description: Enter an amount manually, then choose Income or Expense. For expenses, the app asks for a category so analytics stay useful.

daily-limit.title: Daily budget
daily-limit.description: This shows how much you can spend per day if your current balance is spread evenly until the end of the month.

savings.title: Savings pocket
savings.description: Move money from balance into savings, bring it back when needed, and set a goal to track progress.

templates.title: Recurring actions
templates.description: Add templates for regular transactions like rent, salary, or internet. Then run them with one tap.

report-tabs.title: Report modes
report-tabs.description: The report has separate modes for income, spending, category analytics, and full transaction history.

report-summary.title: Monthly summary
report-summary.description: The top area shows the most important monthly numbers. Analytics makes it easier to spot the biggest spending category.

settings-theme.title: Appearance
settings-theme.description: Choose light, dark, or automatic theme so the app feels comfortable to use.

settings-language.title: Language
settings-language.description: Change the interface language here. Your choice is saved for the next launch.

settings-currency.title: Currency
settings-currency.description: Choose the currency used for balances, expenses, savings, and reports.

settings-reset.title: Reset data
settings-reset.description: Permanently delete all transactions, savings, and templates to start fresh.

done.title: You're all set!
done.description: You can now add your first transaction. The bottom menu will always take you back to the section you need.

notFound.title: This route does not exist
